name: 数据库监控 — 监控体系与工具
description: Oracle 数据库监控体系建设规则。覆盖 Oracle Enterprise Manager (OEM)、Prometheus + Grafana、Zabbix 等监控方案的选型、关键监控指标定义和告警阈值设置。

root_causes.name: 无监控系统
root_causes.desc: 完全无监控，依赖人工巡检发现问题。

root_causes.name: 监控指标不全
root_causes.desc: 有监控但指标覆盖不全，关键维度（如锁、等待事件、备份）未监控。

root_causes.name: 告警阈值不合理
root_causes.desc: 阈值设置过高（漏报）或过低（噪音太多）。

root_causes.name: 监控数据无保留
root_causes.desc: 监控数据保留时间过短，无法做历史趋势分析和容量规划。

step1_key_metrics.desc: 检查关键监控指标是否可采集
step1_key_metrics.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS metric_count FROM v$sysmetric WHERE group_id = 2

step2_wait_events.sql: SELECT wait_class, COUNT(*) AS event_count, ROUND(SUM(time_waited_micro)/1e6) AS total_wait_sec FROM v$system_event WHERE wait_class NOT IN ('Idle') AND total_waits > 100 GROUP BY wait_class ORDER BY total_wait_sec DESC

step3_ash_availability.desc: 检查 ASH 数据可用性
step3_ash_availability.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ash_sample_count FROM v$active_session_history WHERE sample_time > SYSDATE - INTERVAL '1' HOUR
